subject: Quick question about the reading list
text: Hi, can you quickly confirm whether the seminar reading list you sent still includes the second chapter? I thought we agreed to leave it out after the scheduling conflict, but your email makes it look like it stayed in. That may just be a slip, but I want to avoid giving students two different sets of instructions. If it really should be included, let me know before noon, because I need to update the handout. If not, I will remove it now and mention the correction briefly. Please reply soon, even with just yes or no, so I can move ahead without waiting further.
